Package edu.towson.cosc442.halls7800.world

Class Floor

java.lang.Object
edu.towson.cosc442.halls7800.world.Floor
All Implemented Interfaces:
FloorView
public class Floor extends Object implements FloorView
A single dungeon floor: a rectangular grid of Terrain plus what the player has seen.

Floors are mutable (doors open, secret doors are discovered) and are owned by the game session. Later stages attach creatures, items and traps to a floor.
